title: A seam in the string
objective: Find two non-empty strings that are each NFC-normalized, but whose concatenation is not.
graphDescription: NFC runs on each input and on their concatenation.
hints: Start with é in the explorer and inspect its canonical decomposition.
Try putting the base letter in Input A and the combining mark in Input B.
Each input can be normalized alone while their boundary creates a new composition opportunity.
explanation: NFC is not closed under concatenation. A starter at the end of Input A can compose with a combining mark at the start of Input B, even though each input was already NFC on its own.
